title: The Drop of the Free Port
author: Elodie Marchetti
blurb: Ada Oyelaran, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
